Translation.Clip Speed Help: Adjusts visual material playback only. Voiceover, subtitles, and the maximum output duration of each clip are unchanged.
Translation.Match Materials to Script Order Help: Generate keywords and match materials in script order so visuals follow the current voiceover.
Translation.Voiceover Volume Help: Adjusts automatic or uploaded voiceover volume. 100% keeps the original level.
Translation.Voiceover Speed Help: Applies only to automatic voiceover. 1.0× is the normal speed.
Translation.Upload Voiceover File Help: The uploaded audio is used directly instead of generating a voiceover.
Translation.Please Upload Voiceover File First: Please upload a voiceover file first
Translation.Narration Voice Hint: Used for every new short video and audiobook unless you pick a different voice on that screen.
Translation.Custom audio will be used directly. TTS: Custom audio will be used directly. TTS synthesis will be skipped for this task.
Translation.Sonilo Music Prompt Help: Optional style or mood guidance, up to 2000 characters. Leave empty to let Sonilo match the video automatically.
Translation.Sonilo Multiple Videos Warning: Sonilo generates music separately for each output video, so multiple videos consume multiple generations.
Translation.Sonilo API Key Required: Enter a Sonilo API Key to use Sonilo background music.
Translation.Sonilo BGM Fallback Warning: Video {index} was generated without Sonilo background music because the music request failed.
Translation.ElevenLabs API Key Help: This key is shared with ElevenLabs TTS. It is masked and saved in your local config.toml.
Translation.ElevenLabs Music Prompt Help: Optional style or mood guidance, up to 1000 characters. Leave empty to let ElevenLabs match the video automatically.
Translation.ElevenLabs Multiple Videos Warning: ElevenLabs generates music separately for each output video, so multiple videos consume multiple generations.
Translation.ElevenLabs API Key Required: Enter an ElevenLabs API Key to use ElevenLabs background music.
Translation.ElevenLabs Connection Test Succeeded: ElevenLabs account and plan check passed. Music API access will be confirmed during generation.
Translation.ElevenLabs Paid Plan Required: The API Key is valid, but the ElevenLabs Music API requires a paid plan. Upgrade the account before generating music.
Translation.ElevenLabs BGM Fallback Warning: Video {index} was generated without ElevenLabs background music because the music request failed.

Translation.Upload Background Music Help: Upload an MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, FLAC, OGG, OPUS, or WMA file up to 30 MB. It will be stored persistently when video generation starts.
Translation.Invalid Background Music: Please upload a valid supported background music file up to 30 MB.
Translation.Background Music Validation Failed: Background music could not be validated because FFmpeg or storage is unavailable. Please check the server logs.
Translation.Please enter a value between 0 and 100: Please enter a value between 0 and 100

Translation.Voice Preview Duration Unavailable: The preview audio was generated, but its duration could not be read. Check the application logs.

Translation.tts_provider_tips.azure-tts-v2: Requires an Azure Speech **region** and **API key**. Create or view them in the [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_Azure_ProjectOxford/CognitiveServicesHub/~/SpeechServices).
Translation.tts_provider_tips.siliconflow: Requires a SiliconFlow API key from the [console](https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/account/ak). Numeric speed and volume gain are supported.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.gemini-tts: Requires a Gemini API key from [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey). Pace and style are controlled through natural-language instructions.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.mimo-tts: Requires a Xiaomi MiMo API key; see the [first API call](https://mimo.mi.com/docs/quick-start/first-api-call). MiMo V2.5 controls pace and style through natural-language instructions.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.elevenlabs: Requires an [API key](https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys). Add voices to your favorites in the [Voice Library](https://elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library) first.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.chatterbox: Self-hosted. Run a compatible [Chatterbox TTS API](https://github.com/travisvn/chatterbox-tts-api), then enter a Base URL ending in `/v1`; the API key is usually optional.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.kokoro: Fully local and free — no API key, no separate server. The [Kokoro model](https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M) (~90 MB) downloads on first use and then works offline. English voices only.

Translation.Video Cache Management Help: Only automatically downloaded video materials are cleaned. Uploaded materials and generated videos are not affected. Do not clean the cache while generating a video.

Translation.Cache Cleanup Completed: Cache cleanup completed: deleted {count} files and freed {size}.

Translation.Tasks Description: Track generation history, replay videos, and restore parameters.

Translation.Onboarding Creation Settings Description: Enter a topic, then adjust the video, audio, and subtitle options as needed. Most defaults can be used as-is.
Translation.Onboarding Generate Video Description: Start generation after confirming the settings. Track progress and open results from Task Manager at the top.
Translation.Regenerate Task Confirmation: Load this task's script and generation settings? This will replace the current form values, but will not modify the original task or video.
Translation.Task Restore Failed: This task does not contain reusable generation settings.
Translation.Task Configuration Loaded: The historical task configuration has been loaded. Review it, then click Generate Video.
Translation.Task Restore Local Materials Warning: Local materials cannot be restored automatically. Please upload them again.
Translation.Task Restore Custom Audio Warning: Custom audio cannot be restored automatically. Please upload it again.
Translation.Runtime Configuration Busy: A video task is using the current service settings. Try again after it finishes.
Translation.Video Encoder Help: Advanced option. Default follows the app's stable encoder policy, currently libx264. If a selected hardware encoder is unavailable, the app automatically falls back to libx264.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama:
##### Ollama Configuration
- **API Key**: not required
- **Base Url**: usually `http://localhost:11434/v1` for local runs or `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` for Docker{docker_hint}
- **Model Name**: required; run `ollama list` and enter an installed model, such as `qwen:7b`
Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama.docker_hint: > Container environment detected. If Base Url is empty, `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` is used by default.

Translation.llm_provider_tips.moonshot:
##### Kimi / Moonshot Configuration
- **API Key**: register through the [MoneyPrinterTurbo link (10% bonus API credit on your first top-up)]({api_key_url}) and create one in the console
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; see the [model list](https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/models?track_id=track-f6b0a640d35c41deb03b247242a1058c&aff=moneyprinterturbo)

Why recommended:
- **Fits the video creation workflow**: helps generate scripts, extract stock-footage search keywords, and improve final footage relevance
- **Strong long-context capability**: useful for longer topics, batch scripts, and complex prompts
- **Exclusive offer for new users**: receive bonus API credit equal to 10% of the first successful top-up, up to CNY 1,000; offer ends September 30, 2026

Translation.llm_provider_tips.cloudflare:
##### Cloudflare AI Gateway Configuration
- **API Key**: create a token in the [Cloudflare dashboard]({api_key_url}) with `AI Gateway - Read`, `AI Gateway - Edit`, and `Workers AI - Read` permissions
- **Account ID**: enter your Cloudflare account ID
- **Gateway ID**: defaults to `{default_gateway_id}`; you can also enter an existing Gateway ID
- **Base Url**: not required; the REST API endpoint is generated from the Account ID
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; use the `provider/model` format for another model supported by AI Gateway
Translation.llm_provider_tips.minimax:
##### MiniMax Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [China platform](https://platform.minimaxi.com/) or [international platform](https://platform.minimax.io/)
- **Base Url**: use `https://api.minimaxi.com/v1` for China or `{default_base_url}` for international access (default)
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account

Make sure the API Key and Base Url belong to the same platform, or authentication may fail.

Translation.Used for both TTS and Video-to-Music: Used for both TTS and Video-to-Music
Translation.Book Drop Here: Drop a PDF, EPUB or text file here
Translation.Book Drop Hint: PDF, EPUB, TXT and Markdown, up to 64 MB.
Translation.Book Unsupported File: {name} is not a supported book file. Use .epub, .txt or .md.
Translation.Book Library Intro: Open a book to review, split, and render it, or import a new one.
Translation.Book Rename Locked: Wait until rendering finishes to rename this book.
Translation.Book Edit Author Locked: Wait until rendering finishes to change the author.
Translation.Book Delete Warning: This removes the book, its review decisions, every rendered segment, and any generated shorts. Renders still in progress are cancelled.
Translation.Book Ocr Explain: This PDF has no text layer, so every page is being read from its image. It takes a few seconds a page and keeps going if you leave this screen.
Translation.Book Ocr Queued: Queued, waiting for a free slot
Translation.Book Ocr Some Pages Failed: {failed} page(s) could not be read and will be missing from the narration.
Translation.Book Ocr Resume Hint: Pages already read are kept, so resuming only costs what is left.
Translation.Book Ocr Review Note: This book was recognised from page images, not read from a text layer: {pages} pages at {percent}% average confidence. Recognised text can be wrong in ways that sound perfectly fluent, so review it before narrating it.
Translation.Book Review Intro: Nothing is removed silently. Every block the filter dropped is listed below, struck through, with the reason it was dropped and how certain that rule is. One click puts any of them back.
Translation.Book Review Locked: Segments are rendering, so decisions cannot be changed right now.
Translation.Book No Blocks Match: No blocks on this page match the filter. Try another page, or widen the filter.
Translation.Book Keep This Block: Keep this block, so it is narrated
Translation.Book Drop This Block: Drop this block, so it is not narrated
Translation.Book Override Reason Kept: Kept by a reviewer, overriding the automatic decision.
Translation.Book Override Reason Dropped: Dropped by a reviewer, overriding the automatic decision.
Translation.Book Segment Mode Hint chapter: One video per chapter, split further when a chapter runs past the maximum.
Translation.Book Segment Mode Hint duration: Videos are filled towards the target length and closed at the maximum.
Translation.Book Segment Mode Hint smart: Skips the table of contents and other unread lines, then starts each video at a real chapter. The first video names the book, the author, and the opening chapter. Uses your configured LLM and can take a minute on a long book.
Translation.Book Words Per Minute Hint: Used to estimate length before any speech is synthesised.
Translation.Book Segment Invalid invalid: Enter a number in every field.
Translation.Book Segment Invalid min: Lengths must be at least 30 seconds.
Translation.Book Segment Invalid order: The maximum length must be at least the target length.
Translation.Book Segment Invalid wpm: Words per minute must be between 60 and 400.
Translation.Book Plan Locked: Segments are rendering, so the plan cannot be changed right now.
Translation.Book No Segments: No segments yet. Keep at least one block in Review and the plan will fill in.
Translation.Book Rename Segment Locked: Wait until this segment finishes rendering to rename it.
Translation.Book Edit Segment Text: Edit the text of this segment
Translation.Book Show Segment Text: Show the text of this segment
Translation.Book Hide Segment Text: Hide the text of this segment
Translation.Book Segment Text Intro: This is what the segment narrates, in order. Edits are saved against the book, so re-planning keeps them. Saving marks the segment unrendered — render it again when you are done.
Translation.Book Segment No Text: Every block in this segment is dropped, so there is nothing to narrate. Keep one in Review first.
Translation.Book Restore Original Hint: Put back the text as it was extracted from the book.
Translation.Book Retry Needs Render: Pick a voice on the Render tab first. After that you can render segments one at a time.
Translation.Book Render One Hint: Settings above apply to every clip. Render them one at a time, or the whole book at once.
Translation.Book Cover Hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. It is the artwork shown behind the narration, whether that is a still or a moving background.
Translation.Book Cover Burn Hint: Drawn onto the still. Each clip uses that chapter's name; the preview shows the first one.
Translation.Book Template Hint: Animates the cover instead of holding it still. Narration, subtitles and length are unchanged.
Translation.Book Template Missing: This book was rendered with the "{id}" template, which this server no longer offers. Pick another, or leave it and every clip falls back to the still cover.
Translation.Book Template Parts Hint: Tick nothing and the template is only remembered. The card is one short render; the background re-encodes every clip and takes far longer.
Translation.Book Template Accent Hint: Using the colour this template ships with.
Translation.Book Footage Hint: Real clips matched to each segment's text instead of the still cover — expect it to take about eight times as long and produce files about eight times the size.
Translation.Book Footage Source Hint: Where the clips are searched for. Hosted providers need their API key set in Settings.
Translation.Book Music Hint: CC0 public-domain tracks, looped under the narration and faded out at the end of every segment. Upload your own if you want something else.
Translation.Book Music random: Random royalty-free track from the library
Translation.Book Music Pick Required: No track selected, so this book will render without music.
Translation.Book Subtitle Mode Hint burn: Always visible, and the slowest to render.
Translation.Book Subtitle Mode Hint soft: Switched on and off by the player.
Translation.Book Queue Note: {active} rendering, {waiting} waiting (up to {limit} at a time).
Translation.Book Stream Fallback: Live updates were interrupted, so progress is being polled instead.
Translation.Book Busy Rendering: Segments are still rendering. Changing the plan now would throw that work away, so it was refused. Try again once the render finishes.
Translation.Book Busy Shorts: Hook shorts are still being planned or rendered. Wait until that finishes before changing them.
Translation.Book Shorts Intro: AI walks the book passage by passage and writes funny, surprising ~60 second teasers. They are meant to stop a scroller and pull them into the full book video — a beat from the story, not a recap of the ending.
Translation.Book Shorts Not Ready: Import and review the book first. Shorts are written from the text that survives the filter.
Translation.Book Shorts Duration Hint: Spoken length of each teaser. YouTube Shorts and TikTok sit around a minute.
Translation.Book Shorts Max Hint: Spread through the book. Later pages are sampled less so the ending is not spoiled.
Translation.Book Shorts Replace Hint: This replaces the current list, including any shorts you have already rendered.
Translation.Book Shorts Render Hint: Each idea becomes a portrait video with stock footage, narration, and captions. Uses your configured voice and material providers. The YouTube title, description and tags on each short are what get uploaded.
Translation.Book Shorts Empty: No short ideas yet. Find ideas to walk the book and write teasers.
Translation.Book Shorts Hook Hint: The first line that should stop the scroll.
Translation.Book Shorts Script Hint: What the voice says. Saving a change marks the short unrendered.
Translation.Book Shorts Youtube Title Hint: Shown on YouTube. Can name the book; the clip title above stays on-screen.
Translation.Book Shorts Youtube Description Hint: Upload caption. Name the book, invite viewers to the full video, and keep spoilers out.
Translation.Book Shorts Youtube Tags Hint: Comma-separated YouTube tags. No # needed — book title, author, audiobook.
Translation.YouTube Google App Help: In the same Google Cloud project: enable YouTube Data API v3, create an OAuth 2.0 Web client, and add the redirect URI below. Save the Client ID and Secret here, then connect each channel.
Translation.YouTube Enable Api: Enable YouTube Data API v3 in Google Cloud
Translation.YouTube Redirect Uri Help: Copy this into Authorized redirect URIs in Google Cloud Console. For local dev it is usually the Vite origin on port 7777.
Translation.YouTube Privacy Help: Used when publishing by hand, and for auto-upload when Hours between auto-uploads is 0.
Translation.YouTube Auto Schedule Hours Help: Each unpublished video is uploaded one after another and scheduled this many hours after the previous one. 0 publishes immediately using the privacy above. Videos already on YouTube are skipped.
Translation.YouTube Schedule Publish Hint: YouTube keeps the video private until this time, then makes it public. Time is in your local timezone.
Translation.YouTube Schedule Publish Required: Pick a time at least one minute in the future.
Translation.YouTube Channels Help: Each Connect click lets you pick a Google account or Brand Account, so several channels can sit side by side. Reconnect a channel to grant playlist access.
Translation.YouTube OAuth Expired: The sign-in link expired. Connect the channel again.
Translation.YouTube OAuth No Refresh: Google did not return a refresh token. Disconnect the app from your Google account and connect again.
Translation.YouTube OAuth Not Configured: Google Client ID and Secret are not set. Save them first.
Translation.YouTube OAuth Missing Code: Google did not return an authorization code.
Translation.YouTube OAuth Redirect Mismatch: The redirect URI does not match Google Cloud Console. Copy the URI shown on this page into the OAuth client's Authorized redirect URIs, then try again.
Translation.YouTube OAuth Invalid Client: Google rejected the Client ID or Secret. Check they belong to a Web application OAuth client, then save and try again.
Translation.YouTube OAuth Api Disabled: YouTube Data API v3 is disabled on this Google Cloud project. Open the Enable link on this page, click Enable, wait a minute, then connect the channel again.
Translation.YouTube OAuth No Playlist Scope: Google connected the channel but did not grant playlist access. Add the YouTube Data API manage scope on the OAuth consent screen, then reconnect.
Translation.YouTube OAuth Failed: Connecting the YouTube channel failed. Enable YouTube Data API v3 for this Google Cloud project and confirm the redirect URI.
Translation.YouTube Upload No Channels: Connect a YouTube channel in Settings first.
Translation.YouTube Video Description Hint: Up to {max} characters. AI writes a multi-paragraph description — {count} used.
Translation.YouTube Video Tags Hint: Comma-separated. YouTube caps the combined length at 500 characters.
Translation.YouTube Playlist Hint: Optional. Pick an existing playlist or create one. The video is added after upload.
Translation.YouTube Playlist Access Needed: This channel can upload videos, but Google has not granted playlist access yet. Reconnect it and approve the extra permission.
Translation.YouTube Playlist Add Failed: Uploaded, but adding to the playlist failed: {error}
Translation.book_kind.heading: Heading
Translation.book_kind.caption: Caption
